scope: two-stage untouched-episode open-development qualification; route frozen before any new episode outcome is opened
route: exact frozen global B-foreground descriptor top4 + calibrated multiview 3D response + Problem-A X/V_A + frozen N1D normals + deterministic B-hull V_B
teacher_use: evaluator-only after every prediction in the active stage is frozen

robustness_gates.family_G_pass_definition: family median over primary episodes has G direction >=0.70 and G line <=0.10
robustness_gates.episode_index_G_pass_definition: episode-index median over primary families has G direction >=0.70 and G line <=0.10

promotion: Stage A PASS opens Stage B only. Stage A + Stage B PASS authorizes consideration of sealed/external qualification; neither stage alone authorizes product/model-2 handoff.
